name: selfimprove
title: Self-improve
description: Propose a change to the brain's own source, run it as a sibling revision, verify it, promote it.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Open the revisions list; input "docked" composes it for the side panel.

operations.name: request
operations.description: Propose a change set: JSON with branch, summary, files and the verification plan. The answer is the revision's sha in the last neuron.
